args.description: Arguments passed as data to the script.

edits.description: Replacements applied sequentially to this file; any failure leaves the file unchanged.

old_string.description: Unique text to replace; exact match then normalized fallback

replace_all.description: Replace every occurrence; defaults to false

path.description: The absolute path to the file

edits.description: Sequence of edit operations to apply in order

old_string.description: The text to replace (matched exactly, then via normalized fallback)

replace_all.description: When true, replace every occurrence of old_string (defaults to false)

pattern.description: Regex, or literal text when literal is true, to match in file contents.

literal.description: Match text verbatim, including long strings. Default false (regex). Use glob for paths.

path.description: File or directory; defaults to cwd.

type.description: File type such as ts (includes .ts/.tsx/.mts/.cts). Use glob for an exact extension, e.g. *.ts.

output_mode.description: content (default): matching lines; files_with_matches: paths; count: per-file match counts.

-A.description: Following context lines; content mode only.

-B.description: Preceding context lines; content mode only.

context.description: Context lines on both sides; content mode only.

multiline.description: Allow . and matches across newlines; default false.

head_limit.description: Limit output to first N entries. Defaults to 250. Pass 0 to remove the entry-count cap; the source byte budget still applies.

scan_offset.description: Candidate files skipped for SOURCE_INCOMPLETE continuation.

task_name.description: Stable direct-child name used in the Runtime-minted canonical actor path.

objective.description: Detailed multi-step goal for this child agent

read_only.description: true (default) narrows filesystem access to read-only; false retains the parent ceiling.

evidence_refs.description: Optional known evidence. Prefix with file:, diff:, finding:, or exact agent-turn:<canonical-path>#turn=<id>. Legacy agent:<path> resolves latest. Actor output must already be terminal and visible.

model_hint.description: Routing tier: fast for focused lookups (few files/simple grep), deep for heavy multi-file analysis/synthesis, balanced (default/omitted) for normal inherited selection. Unconfigured tiers fall back to the inherited provider/model. Omit when unsure.

agent_id.description: Select a registered specialist matching the task instead of a generic child.

provider.description: Override provider for a deliberate cross-family check. Omit to inherit; an unconfigured provider falls back to yours.

model.description: Model id paired with provider. Omit to inherit.

effort.description: Reasoning effort (off, low, medium, high, xhigh, max). Omit/auto inherits parent/default. A specialist selected by agent_id locks its declared effort; conflicting dispatch or provider/model-unsupported values are rejected.

fork_turns.description: History fork: all (default), none, or a positive recent-turn count.

quality_strategy.description: Telemetry only: {schemaVersion:1,stageId,pattern,role,laneRelation?,targetEvidenceRefs?}. Does not control legal spawn admission; invalid metadata is ignored. Actor targets require exact agent-turn refs.

manifest.description: Workflow metadata. Set readOnly false only if child agents must write files. patterns names the shapes the script uses (one or more of: classify-and-act, fan-out-and-synthesize, adversarial-verification, generate-and-filter, tournament, loop-until-done).

phases.description: Ordered phase names for progress display.

maxAgents.description: Lifetime cap on total child agents across the run.

source.description: JavaScript module body defining `async function run(wf, args) { ... }`. Coordinate child agents only through `wf`; the script gets no fs/network/shell and may not use import/require. Return displayable final text (for example `{ synthesis }`).

args.description: Optional initial arguments passed to run(wf, args).

resumeFromRunId.description: Optional run id of a prior run of THIS workflow to resume from. Re-submit the same script (edited or not) with the prior run id: unchanged agent calls return their cached results instantly and only the changed/new calls re-run. Scripts must be deterministic for this — Date.now()/Math.random() are disabled.

path.description: Optional file or directory scope for the search

limit.description: Maximum number of matches to return

scan_offset.description: Skip candidate files already scanned by a prior SOURCE_INCOMPLETE continuation.

case_sensitive.description: Whether the query should be matched case-sensitively

provider_id.description: Optional extension capability provider id for provider-backed code search

header.description: Short progress label, at most 12 chars.

default.description: Suggested option value for display. Never submitted automatically.

allow_custom_input.description: Defaults to the flat setting or true; false only for closed safety/protocol choices.

custom_input_label.description: Custom-choice label; falls back to flat setting or "Other...".

custom_input_prompt.description: Custom-choice prompt; falls back to flat setting.

custom_input_default.description: Custom-choice initial text; falls back to flat setting.

kind.description: Default select; input ignores options and does not support questions[].

options.description: Choices; required for select, ignored for input.

multi_select.description: Select only: allow multiple choices; answer is an array.

allow_custom_input.description: Automatic custom choice defaults true; false only for closed safety/protocol choices.

custom_input_prompt.description: Prompt for the automatic custom choice.

custom_input_default.description: Initial text for the automatic custom choice.

default.description: Suggested option value (select) or initial text (input) for display. Never submitted automatically.

op.description: Operation mode. Default "update" when omitted — mutate one item by `id`. "init" (legacy / runner-side seeding only) replaces the whole list with `items`; LLMs should NOT call it — it destructively drops any item not echoed back. Use a batch of `todo_create` calls for both initial commitment and mid-task plan growth.

items.description: op="init" (legacy / runner-side only) payload. Each entry: {id: non-empty string (unique within list), subject: non-empty string (brief title), description?: string (fuller context), activeForm?: present-continuous string}. LLMs should use a batch of `todo_create` calls instead.

subject.description: Brief imperative title shown in the plan-list row (e.g. "Run failing tests").

description.description: Optional fuller context / work instructions read when this item is later picked up. Multi-line OK. Skip when subject alone is enough.

activeForm.description: Optional present-continuous form (e.g. "Running failing tests") shown by the spinner when this item flips to in_progress.

evaluator.description: Optional per-step deterministic evaluator. When set and the item flips to "completed", the runner runs `npm run build` / `npm test` / `npm run lint` accordingly; failure surfaces stderr in your next tool result. Use sparingly — only on milestone steps.

id.description: Existing canonical todo id; must match the current plan.

status.description: Optional transition: failed needs retry; skipped is unnecessary; cancelled retains a struck-through breadcrumb; deleted removes the row. Only Runtime may restore pending after revise.

activeForm.description: Present-continuous spinner label; required for in_progress. Omit on terminal transitions to preserve the previous value.

subject.description: Optional replacement imperative title; must be non-empty.

description.description: Optional replacement multi-line work context; empty string clears it.

evaluator.description: Optional replacement completion check when runner evaluator wiring is active: build/test/lint runs npm run build/npm test/npm run lint. Failure returns stderr.

metadata.description: Opaque hook/eval data, not UI. Shallow-merge: keys overwrite, nested objects are not deep-merged; null values delete keys, allowing merge+delete together. Whole-field null clears all (handler accepts it despite object schema).

subject.description: Non-empty imperative milestone title shown in the plan row.

status.description: Default pending; use in_progress for work starting now, avoiding a separate activation call. Creation never completes work.

description.description: Optional multi-line work context available in full item detail; absent from compact row. Omit when subject suffices.

activeForm.description: Optional present-continuous label shown by the in_progress spinner.

evaluator.description: Optional milestone check on completion when runner evaluator wiring is active: build/test/lint runs npm run build/npm test/npm run lint; failure returns stderr. Use sparingly for real checks.

metadata.description: Optional opaque hook/eval data; not shown in UI. Omit when unused.

target_ref.description: Optional target git ref for compare-range review (defaults to HEAD when base_ref is provided)

paths.description: Changed paths inside the workspace; one path is valid

limit_per_path.description: Maximum diff lines per path (default 200, maximum 800)

direction.description: Relationship direction to emphasize. Defaults to both.

include_lsp.description: When true, attach LSP incoming/outgoing call hierarchy evidence when an LSP service is available

include_text_search.description: When true, attach bounded exact-name grep evidence for cross-checking static relationships

name.description: Tool name (must match the value the LLM will use to invoke it).

description.description: One-sentence description of what the tool does.

tools.description: Whitelist of builtin tool names the handler may call via ctx.tools.<name>.

path.description: The absolute file path or a kodax-transient://text/ reference supplied by context recovery

offset.description: Line number to start from (text files only)

limit.description: Number of lines to read (text files only)

line_offset.description: Zero-based Unicode character offset within the first selected line. Use the exact value from a partial-line continuation marker.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does

run_in_background.description: Run command in background. Returns immediately with output file path. Use read tool to check output later.

required_skills.description: Optional skills every returned agent must declare.

required_capabilities.description: Optional lifecycle capabilities required for this dispatch.

read_only.description: When true, exclude external agents whose declared remote effect is write or unknown.

to.description: A visible canonical actor path, direct-child/peer task name, the literal "parent", or "*" for a bounded broadcast. Self-targeted sends are rejected.

content.description: Message body. Runtime wraps it in an authenticated <agent-message> frame before delivery.

forwarded_message_id.description: Message id from a received <agent-message> frame. Supply only when forwarding that message; Runtime derives and validates the forwarding chain. Omit for a fresh message.

classification.description: Data classification. Defaults to internal; forwarding cannot downgrade the source classification.

path_prefix.description: Optional canonical or caller-relative Actor path prefix.

after_path.description: Exclusive canonical path cursor returned as nextAfterPath.

target.description: Canonical controlled actor path or direct-child task name.

scope.description: Interrupt only the target Turn (default) or every active Turn in its controlled subtree. Actors remain reusable.

query.description: Optional search query. Omit or pass an empty string to browse active MCP catalogs.

limit.description: Optional maximum items for this page. Inventory otherwise returns everything that fits the current context; ranked search defaults to 8.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation cursor returned by mcp_search. Pass it alone without query/server/kind/limit.

action.description: Whether to keep or remove the worktree directory and branch

worktree_path.description: Absolute path to the worktree directory

discard_changes.description: If true, bypass safety checks for uncommitted changes or local commits

plan.description: The finalized plan to present to the user. Include the full plan content, not a summary, so the user can make an informed approval decision. Keep the plan tight: at most 40 lines total, 3 bullet-depth levels, one sentence per bullet. If the plan exceeds this budget, split it into phases and present only the current phase — the user can approve phase-by-phase.

blocker_kind.description: Required when status=blocked. A short identifier for the persistent obstacle (e.g. "awaiting-user-permission", "missing-dependency"). The runtime counter compares this string across turns.

target.description: Canonical child path or direct-child task name.

quality_strategy.description: Optional telemetry/provenance for PatternTrace reconstruction. It never controls otherwise legal follow-up admission; invalid or conflicting metadata is ignored.

artifact_json.description: The full ConstructionArtifact as a JSON string.

provider.description: Provider whose tool-schema constraints are checked. Defaults to 'anthropic'.

anchor.description: A unique heading or nearby marker to insert after

content.description: The content to insert after the anchor

query.description: Symbol query text; may be empty for a broad server-supported listing

target_path.description: Optional path inside the workspace to resolve the repository root from

refresh.description: When true, rebuild the repo overview snapshot before returning it

skill.description: The skill name (e.g. "commit", "review-pr"). Leading slash is tolerated.

args.description: Optional arguments forwarded to the skill resolver.

topic.description: A manual topic id (e.g. "providers", "config", "agents", "extensions", "doctor"). Unknown topics return the index.
